goal: Speed up compact block propagation by predictively prefilling missing transactions
Eliminates an extra network round-trip for the roughly 43% of blocks needing fetched transactions
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Praised for simplicity and backward compatibility (josibake)
Verified by running nodes and testing compact block relay across versions (m4ycon, s00ly)
Resolved objections regarding redundant syscalls, logging, and memory safety (andrewtoth, 0xB10C)
Concept approval without stated reasons (edilmedeiros, murchandamus, w0xlt)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it avoids an extra round-trip in roughly 43% of block reconstructions
Faster block propagation across the network lowers the risk of stale blocks
